title: Representation-sensitive retrieval is not sufficient for repeatable action-level propagation across held-out tasks

evidence.retrieval_qualification: 9/9 held-out units show exact-split semantic-set change while ID-placebo and quotient restore the original set
evidence.behavior_pilot: 8/8 fresh executions valid across two outcome-blind hash-selected held-out units and four arms
evidence.unit_22_P21: A=B=C on the frozen five-dimensional signature while D differs, so matched controls are not concordant and no split-specific attribution is available
evidence.unit_21_P19: A=B=C=D on the frozen five-dimensional signature, so retrieval crowd-out produces no separation on the preregistered action-level observable

lesson: A first-party retrieval intervention can be robust across tasks without producing a stable downstream effect on a coarse but preregistered action-level observable. Therefore retrieval-set change must not be treated as behavioral propagation, and additional task runs cannot be justified merely because the retrieval gate is positive.
paper_implication: Keep the archived P19 result as a bounded existence proof. Report the held-out pilot STOP as a failure boundary; do not generalize P19 into a multi-task behavioral claim.
reopen_condition: Reopen multi-task behavioral replication only with a new preregistered design that supplies an independently justified action-level observable with demonstrated control-arm reliability before split outcomes are observed, or a different independently pinned library/substrate with a pre-outcome mechanism-specific behavioral prediction. More held-out tasks, relaxed signature matching, post-hoc action metrics, or outcome-selected units do not reopen this stopped pilot.
forbidden_rescues: run repeat-2 despite stage-1 gate failure
expand to the remaining seven units under the failed contract
replace the five-dimensional primary endpoint after seeing pilot outcomes
select new units using observed behavioral differences
reinterpret tool-call-count differences as the primary endpoint
